source: SuperDerm platform specification §05 (image quality, per photograph).

values.name: Assessable
values.definition: The finding of interest is visible clearly enough to describe.

values.name: Partially assessable
values.definition: Some of the finding can be described, but part is obscured, out of focus or out of frame.

values.name: Unable to assess
values.definition: The photograph cannot be assessed. Give a reason. This never establishes that no lesion is present.
